messages:
anya: quick heads-up, reproducible in staging: trace headers get dropped when gateway fanouts a request into kafka and multiple workers pick up the message. short repro below.
anya: repro steps: 1) client -> gateway injects traceparent + baggage 2) gateway publishes message with headers 3) consumer starts new root spans, no parent. :frowning: 
anya: example of logged headers from gateway: ```headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "traceparent": "00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" }```
matt: do we know which kafka client we use in gateway? some clients only support string headers and will mangle/strip binary or large values.
lisa: we already saw this with SQS. two separate problems: header normalization (lowercasing, ascii-only) and baggage size/shape. when we batch requests we sometimes concat headers which breaks W3C parsing.
jordan: also note autoscaling: if a duplicate reprocess happens, worker may create a new trace which fragments searches. we need deterministic rehydration.
anya: proposal: gateway writes a single curated header `x-rw-trace-v1` containing base64(json{"traceparent":"...","tracestate":"...","baggage":{"user_id":"...","route":"..."},"sampled":true}) so transport quirks are avoided and size is bounded. workers rehydrate and call otel API to set parent.
lisa: pros: predictable, we can whitelist baggage keys and truncate. cons: OT libs won't automatically propagate it so we need a small shim on consumers/gateway.
matt: alternative: emit a few ascii-safe headers: `x-rw-trace-id`, `x-rw-parent`, `x-rw-sampled` and put verbose baggage in message body metadata. keeps trace_id searchable without parsing base64.
jordan: i hacked a prototype for the gateway encoder: ```// nodejs pseudo
const meta = { traceparent, tracestate, baggage: pickBaggage(baggage, ['user_id','route']), sampled }
const hdr = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(meta)).toString('base64')
producer.send({ topic, messages: [{ value: body }], headers: { 'x-rw-trace-v1': hdr } })```
anya: important: workers must prefer original trace id when reprocessing so we don't fork traces on retries. shim should set parent if present and mark span attribute `replayed=true`. also emit `orig_trace_id` log field.
lisa: sampling: gateway must include sampled flag, otherwise worker will re-sample and drop low-sampled traces. include `sampled` boolean in the curated header.
matt: header size exceeded alerts just fired on prod-kafka cluster earlier. we need strict size limit and truncation metrics. don't pass full baggage.
jordan: ops bot flagged: "kafka: header-size-exceeded" in alerts. we should record gauge for dropped_baggage_count and per-topic header_bytes.
anya: rollout plan proposal: 1) gateway encoder + baggage whitelist + truncation 2) consumer shim library (rehydrate + set parent/span + sampled) 3) Console: index `orig_trace_id` and add stitcher for split traces 4) short TTL mapping (Redis) for old_trace_id->new_parent for 60s to help correlation on duplicates 5) integration tests for kafka/sqs/batched messages.
lisa: add integration tests matrix (kafka/sqs, batch sizes, permuted baggage). also SLA: ensure trace_id searchable in Console within 30s after processing.
matt: i'll own gateway encoder + unit/integration tests. please grant staging-kafka access.
dev-ops-bot: @matt your staging-kafka access request #4578 has been opened for review.
anya: i'll file a Console issue to add `orig_trace_id` mapping and a short UX note about stitched traces.
jordan: minor compatibility note: shim must be idempotent and not overwrite an existing `traceparent` header if another service already set it. preserve existing when present.
lisa: :thumbsup: after tests + canary and observability (trace counts, sampled rate) we can ship.
anya: cool — i'll create follow-up threads for PRs and test ownership. thank you!
